text: Cataloging, classifying, writing quality rules, merging duplicate records -- fix our trust problem quietly contains four different projects. This video draws a hard line around what actually ships first.

V1 is catalog and classify: register and scan all five systems, assign a named owner to every critical data element, and label every sensitive column. Quality rules and master data management are sequenced next, in this same engagement.

The CDO wants the duplicate-record problem fixed too, while we're in there. It's a real need -- but merging records safely requires a trustworthy catalog and classification first, so it's phase three, not forgotten.
Every deferred item gets a phase and a reason, in writing, not a silent drop -- that's what keeps trust intact when the next request comes in mid-build.
Catalog and classify, signed and scoped. Next: the first real architecture decision -- what platform actually runs this.
